draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.68, the 231st-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 19th of 20 at S. He went 208th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 52 tackles in 2022, 20th of 20 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Tennessee Titans. 4 career games and 2 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (1 AV) was his best yet. Weak spots: missed tackle rate 15.4% (8th percentile), approximate value 1 (11th percentile). Played 4 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-3 safety who played: 13.1% season snap share against a median of 51.8%, below the norm.
